mapper.select:
select tcp.id as passId, product.id as productId, product.serial_number as productSerialNumber, product.name as productName, tcpwt.welding_serial_number as weldingSerialNumber, tcpwt.product_type as productType, tcccs.serial_number as techCappCraftCardStorehouseSerialNumber, tcccs.welding_base_welding_position as weldingBaseWeldingPosition, cppl.welding_craft_parameter_pass as weldingCraftParameterPass, tcp.equiment_serial_number as equimentSerialNumber, tcp.equiment_code as equimentCode, tcp.equiment_name as equimentName, tcp.weld_user_name as weldUserName, tcp.start_time as startTime, tcp.end_time as endTime, cppl.electricity as ratedElectricity, cppl.voltage as ratedVoltage from tech_capp_craft_product_pass_task as tcp left join tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse as tcccs on tcp.tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_id = tcccs.id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON tcp.product_id = product.id and product.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble product ON tcp.product_id = product.id and product.bool_delete_enum = 0
left join tech_capp_craft_product_weld_task as tcpwt on tcpwt.id = tcp.tech_capp_craft_product_weld_task_id and tcpwt.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_craft_parameter_pass_link as cppl on cppl.id = tcp.tech_capp_craft_card_storehouse_craft_parameter_pass_link_id
tcp.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tcp.tech_capp_product_task_work_type = 4
and tcp.project_id = #{projectId}
and tcpwt.welding_serial_number like concat('%',#{weldSerialNumber},'%')
and tcp.monomer_id = #{monomerId}
and tcp.area_id = #{areaId}
and tcp.product_type = #{productType}
and product.serial_number like concat('%',#{productSerialNumber},'%')
and product.name like concat('%',#{productName},'%')
and tcccs.serial_number like concat('%',#{techCappCraftCardStorehouseSerialNumber},'%')
order by product.serial_number, cppl.sort, tcp.create_time
